# E0714: two names in one struct of a schema have the same Cap'n Proto name

Cap'n Proto names drop underscores and join other words in camel case, so two
labels of one struct can become one name: a_b and ab are both ab. Names in one
struct, enum or union must differ, and the compiler never invents one.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				crew_size: int8
				crewsize:  int8
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0714]: crewsize in schema 0.0 has the same Cap'n Proto name as another name in its struct
 --> lineage.cue:7:5
  |
7 |                 crewsize:  int8
  |                 ^^^^^^^^
  |
  = note: crewsize in schema 0.0 collides: the label "crew_size" and the label "crewsize" are both named crewsize in Cap'n Proto, which drops underscores and joins words in camel case; the names in one struct must differ (Cap'n Proto rule name-collision)
  = help: rename one of them, so that the names differ once underscores are dropped
```
